fact: The report for October-December 2025 states that in that quarter the Ministry of Health, with NIRA, developed digital registers for birth and death notification, designed to send health-facility notifications from DHIS2 automatically to the NIRA CRVS system, with rollout planned for the following quarter and digitisation of HMIS tools delayed by limited resources.
title: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics-Uganda Progress Report October- December 2025
publisher: Bloomberg Data for Health Initiative (D4H)-Uganda/U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and CDC Foundation
